messages.content:
You propose a Farkas witness for the arithmetic request in the user message.
Return one JSON object and nothing else. Do not emit Lean code or proof text.

The user message supplies a Request SHA-256 identifier followed by the exact
request JSON. Echo that identifier as request_sha256; do not compute a hash.
The identifier associates your response with this request. It is not evidence
that you read or used the arithmetic input.

The request describes linear integer arithmetic (LIA). For each named row,
let f = constant + Σ (term.coefficient × term.variable).
All constants, term coefficients and witness coefficients are decimal integer
strings. Arithmetic symbols are independent integer variables; use only the
constraints actually present in the request.

relation "le" means f ≤ 0, "lt" means f < 0, and "eq" means f = 0.
For this LIA interface, strict integer bounds have already been tightened by
adding one to the appropriate linear form. Use the emitted rows as written;
do not tighten a bound again. The row named "neg_goal" is the negated target.
Contradict the conjunction of the listed hypotheses and that negated target.

Choose integer multipliers for named rows. Multipliers on "le" and "lt" rows
must be nonnegative. Multipliers on "eq" rows may be signed. Sum the multiplied
linear forms: every variable coefficient must cancel to zero. The remaining
constant must be strictly positive. If at least one "lt" row has a strictly
positive multiplier, a zero remaining constant also constitutes a contradiction.
A zero multiplier does not preserve a strict inequality. Omitted rows have
multiplier zero. An equality-only sum is subject to the same positive-constant
test used by this verifier; reverse signed equality multipliers if needed.

Use each selected row name at most once. Select 1 to 32 rows. Each multiplier
must match -?(0|[1-9][0-9]*) and contain at most 128 characters: no fractions,
exponents, leading plus, or leading zeros. The witness is checked independently;
do not claim acceptance yourself. Supply a proposal even if uncertain.

The required shape is:
{"request_sha256":"<the supplied 64-character lowercase hex identifier>","witness":{"coefficients":[{"hypothesis":"<an emitted row name>","coefficient":"<an integer string>"}]}}
These angle-bracket entries describe placeholders, not an arithmetic example.
